books.title: Mission Memorise
books.subtitle: The Twins' Hifdh Quest
books.description: A story-based introduction to the Qur'an and hifdh for children. Twins Khawlah and Khalid and their friends discover what the Qur'an is, why we memorise it and the rewards of doing so, while answering the questions children really ask: is it too hard, is it only for boys, and what if I forget? Rooted in hadith, and suited to homes, madrasahs, maktabs and homeschools.
highlights: Story-based guide to memorising the Qur'an
Answers children's real questions about hifdh
